GHA.note: Nothing on AI rules or an authority.
University use of Gemini is not a government administration body's AI system.
Education licences for a university are not a public sector system producing outputs.

facts.fact: Vice-Chancellor Christian Agyare referred to university AI experts contributing to the development of Ghana's national AI strategy, implying it was still being developed.

GHA.note: Google's Gemini and NotebookLM are foreign products used locally, with nothing built or hosted in Ghana.
No data protection law is stated.
No STEM graduate share or national research network is stated.
